title: Review of c52's predator competition by taxis on fresh seed 23: equal kinds coexist (24.4 vs 23.9 bodies) and the kind without taxis holds no bodies (0.0 vs 36.7)
summary: Labkit runs of world2p.py, 128^2, t=10000, seed 23. Mean body counts (c > 0.5, area >= 4) over t >= 5000, prey / kind b / kind e: equal kinds 38.8 / 24.4 / 23.9; chiFe 0 (kind e without taxis) 42.0 / 36.7 / 0.0 (labkit: e mean 1.3 bodies, max 12, final 2). The finding reports 43.7/24.4/22.2 and 42.2/21.4/23.2 (equal) and 34.6/32.0/3.7 and 33.9/30.5/1.5 (chiFe 0).

observations.X: equal/FACTS.md and notaxis/FACTS.md (seed 23): equal kinds 24.4 vs 23.9 bodies; without taxis kind e 0.0 against kind b 36.7 over t >= 5000

seeds_run.result: pass for the equal arm and the chiFe 0 arm

verdicts.limitation: Two of the five arms (no half-taxis or digestion-rate arms), one seed. Prey in the no-taxis arm are 42.0 here against 34-35 in the finding. The taxis is a written drift and kinds are fixed: competition between two species, not selection.
